newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal manufacturing industry confidence up - INE.
newsitem.headline: Portugal manufacturing industry confidence up - INE.

text.p: The confidence index of Portuguese manufacturing industry rose in August, extending a trend registered over the past two months, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said in its latest report.
The index, which is not expressed in figures, reflected the more favourable views of businessmen about activity in their sectors, the outlook for demand and production, as well as stock levels.
"There is still only moderate optimism about a rise in prices," it said.
